label: Community member
description: A person learning how to understand needs and act responsibly through public information and reviewed pathways.

label: Parent or caregiver
description: A caregiver seeking safe, practical learning and referral awareness without direct-risk programming.

label: Student
description: A learner or student leader preparing a briefing, workshop, campus action lab, or responsible support project.

label: Donor
description: A supporter learning how to read evidence, caveats, and official support channels before acting.

label: NGO manager
description: A practitioner or manager reviewing competencies needed for accountable program support.

label: Teacher
description: An educator exploring temporary learning, safeguarding, civic education, and trauma-informed learning boundaries.

label: Health worker
description: A health-oriented learner using official public-health resources and non-clinical preparedness content.

label: University lab
description: A university team designing tools, data projects, or learning events under partner review and safety constraints.

label: Peacebuilder
description: A facilitator or practitioner connecting humanitarian need to conflict transformation and social repair.

label: Policy advocate
description: A civic or policy actor preparing sourced advocacy for humanitarian access and civilian protection.

label: Technologist
description: A builder designing public-interest tools with privacy, data minimization, and partner review.

label: Community leader
description: A local or civic leader preparing collective learning, preparedness, or partner-mediated action.
